# Phase 2 step 1 (docs/superpowers/archive/specs/2026-10-12-demographics-phase2-consequences-design.md §1.7): the
# working-adult lines' women's-work and replaced families, re-applied by a fixed-sign pair while
# te_demog_workforce_lines_apply holds (not Full, or no te_dg_mw: step 2's term). Their own files, gate and
# refresh, so the census's births and deaths term never takes them off. A release keeps them.
# THIS = ROOT = a state, beside te_demog_lines_refresh at both its call sites: the working-adult pair at the
# families' sum while te_demog_workforce_lines_apply holds; otherwise (step 2's workforce term in force) off.
te_demog_workforce_lines_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_demog_workforce_lines_apply = yes }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_ln_new value = te_demog_line_working_adults }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_working_adults }
					NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_working_adults = local_var:te_dg_ln_new }
					# a pair lost while its sum stayed (a save quirk, a state that copied the variable): put it back
					AND = {
						NOT = { var:te_dg_ln_working_adults = 0 }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_up }
						NOT = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_down }
					}
				}
			}
			te_demog_line_working_adults_remove = yes
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_ln_working_adults value = local_var:te_dg_ln_new }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_ln_working_adults > 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = te_demog_line_working_adults_up multiplier = te_demog_line_working_adults_up_mult }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_ln_working_adults < 0 }
				add_modifier = { name = te_demog_line_working_adults_down multiplier = te_demog_line_working_adults_down_mult }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		te_demog_workforce_lines_clear = yes
	}
}

# THIS = a state: the working-adult pair off, with its stored sum (step 2's term calls it when it first lands).
te_demog_workforce_lines_clear = {
	te_demog_line_working_adults_remove = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_ln_working_adults }
		remove_variable = te_dg_ln_working_adults
	}
}

te_demog_line_working_adults_remove = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_up }
		remove_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_up
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_down }
		remove_modifier = te_demog_line_working_adults_down
	}
}
